name: Georgia: individual entrepreneurs with small business status

tests: More than 183 days in any 12 months

regimes.name: Foreign income exempt
regimes.summary: Individuals are not taxed on foreign-source income

source.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Georgia, residence

calendar.note: Small business status holders declare and pay 1% of turnover by the 15th of the following month; VAT payers file and pay VAT by the 15th of the following month too.

presets.label: Small business status: 1% of turnover, no VAT
Small business status registered for VAT: VAT 18% + 1% of turnover

items.name: small_business_tax
items.label: Small business status: 1% of turnover up to GEL 500,000, 3% above

notes: The 1% regime applies up to the annual turnover limit of the status (GEL 500,000); above it the general regime applies. VAT registration is required above GEL 100,000 of turnover.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
